evidence: ADR-068 (11 Sep 2026): apps/api routes/live.ts positions accountId; lib/api/live.ts useAccountPositions, lib/accounts.ts accountRefOf / useCurrentAccount, PaperPanel.tsx drift per account, NetPositionsPanel.tsx net-account, PortfolioBar.tsx; unit trading-live.test.tsx HC-TR-174, HC-TR-175
